subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should OpenClaw allow `loadAuthProfileStoreForAgent` to lazily import legacy `auth-profiles.json` at runtime, or must this recovery move into doctor/startup migration code before merge?
rationale: Both choices affect the upgrade contract for credential storage: runtime lazy import fixes a severe auth break quickly, but repository policy currently keeps legacy file reads out of canonical runtime paths.

options.title: Move recovery to migration boundary
options.body: Implement first-run/startup or doctor-driven migration that imports legacy JSON into SQLite before runtime auth resolution, preserving SQLite-only runtime behavior.

options.title: Approve narrow runtime exception
options.body: Allow this PR's lazy import path as a temporary or documented compatibility bridge for stranded shipped credentials, with explicit tests and removal criteria.

options.title: Pause for broader auth migration plan
options.body: Hold this branch until related auth migration PRs and the open user-facing issue are unified into one maintainer-sponsored upgrade path.

recommendation.title: Move recovery to migration boundary
recommendation.body: Implement first-run/startup or doctor-driven migration that imports legacy JSON into SQLite before runtime auth resolution, preserving SQLite-only runtime behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner signal is closest to the current auth-profile runtime and migration boundary in recent repository history.
